coordinateSystem: Unmodified DAMIT co-rotating Cartesian frame; positive Z is the north pole; positive X defines the meridian; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: DAMIT model 1813, version 2017-06-14: ecliptic J2000 lambda 76 deg, beta 55 deg, period 4.843928 h; equatorial J2000 conversion uses obliquity 23.439291111 deg. The original model page and DAMIT frame documentation are pinned. The display does not claim the source epoch phase.
